Definition

A boundary defining function for a smooth manifold with boundary $M$ is a smooth map $f:M\to [0,\infty )$ such that $f^{-1}(0)=\partial M$ and $df_p\neq 0$ for every $p\in \partial M$. For the closed unit ball $\overline{\mathbb B}^n$, the function $f(x)=1-|x|^2$ is boundary defining.
